title: Exercise prepared native snapshot invalidation at provider enqueue
outcome: A deterministic regression proves that provider composition clears a native opening snapshot already installed for a stale acknowledged root, and delivers the prompt with the reason attribution is withheld.
acceptance: Install a native S0 snapshot under a valid prepared selection, mutate the selected name after installation and before provider enqueue, and assert both the refusal reason and absence of the installed snapshot.
Preserve the pre-S0 drift tests and positive unchanged-selection control.
